title_en: Duplex with two garages at Kodra e Diellit 1!
description_en: Duplex with two garages at Kodra e Diellit 1! We offer a duplex for sale at Kodra e Diellit Residence 1. The duplex is located on the first and second floor of a well-managed building, part of the Residence. Kodra e Diellit stands out for a perfect organization of common spaces, tranquility, clean air positioned very close to urban life. It is organized in a living room with a kitchen area and a toilet on the first floor, two bedrooms, a toilet and a balcony on the second floor. Along with the apartment included in the price, there is also a closed garage for two cars and a storage area of ​​73m2. For more information, do not hesitate to contact me.
